reproduction_procedure: In commit a9b564b, pipeline.py read fwd_model from metadata but unconditionally called simulate_diffraction, bypassing F2-F6.
expected_behavior: When profile specifies forward_model in {F1..F6}, simulate_forward_model routes execution to the corresponding physical forward operator.
actual_behavior: Models F1-F6 are actively dispatched via simulate_forward_model in forward.py.
scientific_consequences: In unpatched versions, synthetic observations labeled as Fresnel, aberrated probe, polychromatic, or 3D particles were identical to Fraunhofer diffraction.
proposed_remedy: Route forward_model through simulate_forward_model dispatcher in physics/forward.py.

reproduction_procedure: In commit a9b564b, forward.py computed observed_masked but returned unmasked intensity_measured, writing raw readouts to HDF5 input.
expected_behavior: Detector regions covered by beamstops, module gaps, or dead pixels must contain 0.0 in observed_input, while unmasked readout is kept in intensity_raw.
actual_behavior: intensity_observed strictly zeros out masked pixels (intensity_observed[~mask] == 0.0) and is stored as input.
scientific_consequences: Information leakage allowed machine learning models and inverse solvers to cheat by reading true diffraction signals behind physical beamstops.
proposed_remedy: Separate intensity_raw from intensity_observed; write intensity_observed to HDF5 input; maintain zero-leakage property alias.

reproduction_procedure: In commit a9b564b, when intensity_expected was missing from a shard, torch_dataset.py executed clean_arr = inp_arr.
expected_behavior: Loaders must raise descriptive KeyError when a required supervised ground-truth target is missing.
actual_behavior: KeyError is raised if clean target is requested but absent from HDF5 file.
scientific_consequences: Supervised models were trained to predict noisy input as its own clean target, rewarding identity mapping.
proposed_remedy: Raise explicit KeyError on missing targets; require extended storage or deterministic target reconstruction.

reproduction_procedure: Compact storage omits intensity_expected and intensity_ideal to save disk space, but tasks T2 and T3 advertised supervised clean targets.
expected_behavior: Compact schema must explicitly document supported tasks (T1 phase retrieval); supervised restoration tasks must require extended storage or companion target generation.
actual_behavior: Compact schema provides input, target, mask; extended schema provides all physical reference modalities; tasks check target availability.
scientific_consequences: Users training denoising or inpainting models on compact releases encounter missing clean ground truth.
proposed_remedy: Explicitly distinguish Compact and Extended storage contracts in schemas and task manifests.

reproduction_procedure: Inspect loader.py and benchmarks/eval_*.py. OpenDiffractionDataset does not accept manifest_path; evaluation scripts loop through range(num_samples) rather than indexing exact sample_id keys.
expected_behavior: Evaluators and dataset loaders must enforce exact sample_id membership and ordering from the task manifest.
actual_behavior: Evaluation loops index sequential rows rather than strictly resolving sample_id to (shard, row_index).
scientific_consequences: Evaluations run on arbitrary dataset slices rather than the curated, stratified task manifests, invalidating benchmark comparisons.
proposed_remedy: Add sample_id index mapping to loader and torch dataset; make evaluation scripts iterate over manifest sample_ids.

reproduction_procedure: In commit a9b564b, fresnel.py applied fftshift to the spatial field after ifft2, displacing the propagated object by (N/2, N/2) even at z = 0.
expected_behavior: At z = 0, propagated field must equal input field within numerical precision: ||U(0) - U0|| < 1e-12.
actual_behavior: Spurious spatial fftshift removed; zero-distance identity verified: max norm error is 4.62e-16.
scientific_consequences: Fresnel propagation inverted real-space coordinate origin and corrupted boundary conditions.
proposed_remedy: Remove post-ifft2 fftshift on spatial field; center Fourier transfer function properly.

reproduction_procedure: Inspect forward.py:81-125 pad_object_to_detector. The offset parameter shifts object placement in real space. By the Fourier shift theorem, |FFT(f(x-x0))|^2 = |F(q)|^2, leaving diffraction intensity unchanged.
expected_behavior: Beam center displacement on the detector must shift the center of the far-field diffraction pattern (q_x, q_y) or tilt the incident illumination wavevector.
actual_behavior: Translating the object inside the zero-padded frame produces identical far-field diffraction modulus, failing to shift the diffraction pattern center.
scientific_consequences: V19 (jitter) and V40 (off-center hit) do not exhibit the intended diffraction center displacement on the detector.
proposed_remedy: Implement detector-coordinate shift (roll / interpolation) or incident probe phase ramp (tilt) so diffraction pattern shifts on the detector.

reproduction_procedure: Inspect transmission.py generate_probe. It accepts defocus_rad, astigmatism_rad, coma_rad, but lacks spherical_aberration_rad. In profiles_48.py, V17 sets spherical_aberration_waves, which is ignored.
expected_behavior: All declared profile parameters (defocus, spherical aberration, astigmatism, coma) must modulate the complex probe field.
actual_behavior: V17 spherical aberration is recorded in metadata but omitted from probe phase computation.
scientific_consequences: V17 generates an uncorrupted Gaussian probe instead of a spherically aberrated probe.
proposed_remedy: Add spherical_aberration_rad parameter to generate_probe with quartic wavefront phase W(r) proportional to r^4.

reproduction_procedure: In commit a9b564b, background types gas_scattering, support_film_halo, solvent_halo, and slit_streaks were connected, and cosmic_ray was added to raw readout.
expected_behavior: All declared parasitic background scattering models must contribute physical photon rates to intensity_expected and detector readouts.
actual_behavior: Background models generate isotropic halos, carbon rings, solvent rings, slit flare, and cosmic hits.
scientific_consequences: Ensures that background scattering benchmarks reflect experimental parasitic scatter.
proposed_remedy: Verify background addition before Poisson sampling for optical scatter, and post-Poisson for detector electronic ionization.

reproduction_procedure: In commit a9b564b, V47 3D volume was generated per acquisition shot with fresh RNG seeds. Fixed in 345095b by caching volume_3d in metadata.
expected_behavior: 3D density volume must remain invariant across acquisitions while Euler angles rotate the volume before 2D transmission projection.
actual_behavior: volume_3d is preserved and rotated via rotation_matrix_euler(*angles) before 2D projection.
scientific_consequences: Maintains object identity invariance across acquisition shots while permitting deterministic orientation sweeps.
proposed_remedy: Maintain volume_3d in base object metadata and apply Euler rotation in project_volume_to_2d.

reproduction_procedure: Inspect pipeline.py:272-276. If metadata does not contain wavelength_m or pixel_pitch_m, default constants 1.24e-10, 7.5e-5, 0.5 are used regardless of scenario S1-S6.
expected_behavior: Manifest records the physical wavelength, energy, pixel pitch, and distance corresponding to the active scenario or profile.
actual_behavior: Fallback constants are written unless explicitly provided in profile metadata.
scientific_consequences: Users cannot rely on metadata for physical wavelength scaling or quantitative inverse problems.
proposed_remedy: Map profiles to scenarios S1-S6 and populate manifest physical geometry directly from active ScenarioSpec.

reproduction_procedure: In commit a9b564b, DPR target scaling target = O * s was conflated with unscaled physical ground truth object_amplitude = O.
expected_behavior: Target scaling contracts must be explicit: target stores DPR scaled density (O * s), object_amplitude stores unscaled physical amplitude [0, 1].
actual_behavior: Both target_dpr and object_amplitude are stored in extended mode, and contract is documented in DATASET_CARD.md.
scientific_consequences: Clarifies whether neural networks are evaluated against flux-scaled targets or true scale-invariant physical phantoms.
proposed_remedy: Document DPR scaling convention and provide unscaled physical ground truth in extended schema.

reproduction_procedure: Inspect benchmarks/phase_retrieval.py:66. initial_phase = np.angle(np.fft.fft2(np.fft.ifftshift(hio_recon))) is uncentered, but error_reduction calls curr_phase = np.fft.ifftshift(initial_phase), shifting Fourier phase by (N/2, N/2).
expected_behavior: State transfer from HIO to ER must preserve Fourier spatial frequencies without coordinate origin shifts.
actual_behavior: ifftshift on already uncentered phase scrambles Fourier phase upon entry into ER.
scientific_consequences: ER begins iteration with inverted Fourier phase, causing step-function error increases or convergence degradation.
proposed_remedy: Pass centered phase (fftshift) or pass real-space object directly into ER initialization.

reproduction_procedure: In commit a9b564b, HIO and ER forced Fourier amplitudes to 0 at masked pixels.
expected_behavior: Unmeasured Fourier pixels (beamstop, gaps) must remain unconstrained or updated solely from current iterate.
actual_behavior: Masked Fourier pixels are left unconstrained: G_mod = np.where(v_mask, modulus * np.exp(1j * G_phase), G).
scientific_consequences: Eliminates artificial beamstop-shaped high-frequency artifacts and allows proper iterative convergence.
proposed_remedy: Apply Fourier modulus constraint strictly where valid_mask is True.

reproduction_procedure: In commit a9b564b, phase_retrieval.py computed normalized squared error as error metric.
expected_behavior: Crystallographic Fourier R-factor must be sum(|scale * |G| - |F||) / sum(|F|) over valid detector pixels.
actual_behavior: Standard crystallographic R-factor is computed and reported.
scientific_consequences: Ensures reported R-factors match experimental crystallography and CDI literature.
proposed_remedy: Implement crystallographic R-factor with optimal scale factor over valid mask.

reproduction_procedure: Inspect opendiffraction/tasks/metrics.py:50-64. ssim_2d computes a single global scalar variance and covariance across the entire image instead of standard local windowed SSIM.
expected_behavior: SSIM must be computed using local sliding Gaussian windows (e.g. 11x11, sigma=1.5, Wang et al. 2004) or call skimage.metrics.structural_similarity when available.
actual_behavior: Global scalar variance formula is evaluated, diverging from standard windowed SSIM definitions.
scientific_consequences: Global SSIM ignores local structural variations and can produce distorted similarity scores on high-contrast phantoms.
proposed_remedy: Implement standard windowed SSIM with uniform/Gaussian kernel, or use skimage.metrics.structural_similarity with local fallback.

reproduction_procedure: Inspect benchmarks/eval_phase_retrieval.py:68. pearsonr(target.ravel(), np.clip(target.ravel(), 0, 1)) correlates target with clipped target.
expected_behavior: Reconstruction diagnostic must correlate reconstructed object with ground truth object after spatial and twin alignment.
actual_behavior: Correlates ground truth with clipped ground truth, ignoring the reconstruction entirely.
scientific_consequences: Reports trivial correlation ~1.0 regardless of reconstruction quality.
proposed_remedy: Correlate aligned reconstructed array with ground truth array.

reproduction_procedure: Inspect benchmarks/phase_retrieval.py:53. A hardcoded circular disc of radius 28 px is used as default support mask.
expected_behavior: Benchmark must document and separate support information regimes: oracle support, estimated autocorrelation support, or loose support.
actual_behavior: Fixed circular mask applied to all objects regardless of true morphology or aspect ratio.
scientific_consequences: Elongated objects (nanorods, nanowires, lithographic lines) are clipped by circular support, penalizing reconstruction.
proposed_remedy: Support oracle support derived from ground truth dilation, autocorrelation-based support estimation, or loose bounding box.

reproduction_procedure: Inspect opendiffraction/physics/masks.py:288-289. if np.mean(mask) < 0.2: mask[:] = True silently resets mask to fully valid.
expected_behavior: Severe masks must either be retained as valid stress test cases, resampled, or raise ValueError.
actual_behavior: Severe masks with valid coverage < 20% are silently erased and replaced by a defect-free detector.
scientific_consequences: Adversarial or severe mask scenarios (e.g. V48) can be silently transformed into clean, defect-free masks.
proposed_remedy: Remove silent mask wipeout; provide explicit mask policy allowing severe masks or controlled resampling.

reproduction_procedure: Run generate with preset='quick' (48 samples). With acquisitions_per_object=4, only 12 base objects are created, sampling only V01 to V12.
expected_behavior: Quick smoke test preset must cover all 48 profiles V01-V48 (1 sample per profile, acquisitions_per_object=1), as documented in README and quick.yaml.
actual_behavior: Only 12 unique profiles are generated in quick mode.
scientific_consequences: Smoke tests fail to exercise 75% of the profile registry (V13 to V48).
proposed_remedy: Set acquisitions_per_object=1 when preset is 'quick' so all 48 profiles are generated.

reproduction_procedure: In commit a9b564b, entire shards of 480 samples were accumulated in memory before writing to disk.
expected_behavior: Observations must be written incrementally to bounded-memory temporary HDF5 files.
actual_behavior: IncrementalShardWriter streams samples individually (<120 MiB RAM peak).
scientific_consequences: Eliminates OOM crash risks on standard CPU systems during dataset generation.
proposed_remedy: Use IncrementalShardWriter with chunked dataset allocation.

reproduction_procedure: In commit a9b564b, verify_shard checked only sample count and basic dataset keys.
expected_behavior: Resume logic must verify cryptographic configuration hash and sample integrity checksums.
actual_behavior: SHA-256 configuration fingerprint and sample checksums are checked during shard verification.
scientific_consequences: Prevents silent data corruption or reuse of mismatched shards upon resumed generation.
proposed_remedy: Store and verify config_hash attribute in HDF5 root group.

reproduction_procedure: Historical manifests had 91.4% single hits and 2.8% blank exposures. Rectified Gaussian readout noise yielded ~44,000 false photons on blanks.
expected_behavior: Hit finding benchmark must be evaluated on balanced classes with 3-sigma readout noise floor gating.
actual_behavior: Balanced 4-class evaluation manifest created (25% each); 3-sigma readout noise gate applied; 100% balanced accuracy achieved.
scientific_consequences: Eliminates trivial classification artifacts and false photon integration from electronic noise.
proposed_remedy: Implement balanced manifest generation and 3-sigma energy floor gating.

reproduction_procedure: Evaluating inpainting using only global SSIM can mask severe reconstruction errors in occluded regions because unmasked pixels dominate.
expected_behavior: Inpainting benchmarks must report localized metrics (MAE, RMSE) strictly over the masked/missing regions.
actual_behavior: eval_inpainting.py computes and reports Masked Region MAE and RMSE.
scientific_consequences: Provides truthful assessment of inpainting performance inside beamstop shadows and module gaps.
proposed_remedy: Report Masked Region MAE/RMSE alongside global PSNR/SSIM.

reproduction_procedure: quick.yaml states samples_per_profile=1 (48 samples), starter.yaml states samples_per_profile=50 (2400 samples), full.yaml states 9600 samples. Pipeline default acquisitions_per_object=4 produces different object counts.
expected_behavior: CLI presets, YAML configs, and README descriptions must specify consistent sample and profile counts.
actual_behavior: Discrepancy exists between preset sample counts and profile coverage under acquisitions_per_object=4.
scientific_consequences: Users running presets obtain unexpected profile distributions.
proposed_remedy: Synchronize preset configurations and document exact object and acquisition counts.

reproduction_procedure: Earlier artifacts referenced v2.0 and v3.0 schemas interchangeably.
expected_behavior: Release metadata and schema versions must be consistently labeled 3.1.0 across documentation and code.
actual_behavior: Version updated to 3.1.0 in pyproject.toml, version.py, README.md, DATASET_CARD.md, CHANGELOG.md.
scientific_consequences: Eliminates version confusion between historical releases and remediated software.
proposed_remedy: Maintain centralized version in version.py and synchronize release documentation.

reproduction_procedure: Inspect .github/workflows/tests.yml line 34. pytest runs only 6 test files, omitting storage, loaders, benchmarks, and remediation tests.
expected_behavior: CI test matrix must execute all unit and regression test suites across supported Python versions.
actual_behavior: CI workflow currently runs a restricted subset of test files.
scientific_consequences: Regressions in storage, data loaders, masking, and phase retrieval can pass CI undetected.
proposed_remedy: Update .github/workflows/tests.yml to execute python -m pytest tests/ with proper test coverage.

reproduction_procedure: Fraunhofer operates on dimensionless pixel grids, while Fresnel operates in SI units (meters, radians).
expected_behavior: Unit definitions and sampling criteria (e.g. Fresnel Shannon sampling bounds) must be explicitly verified and documented.
actual_behavior: Airy disk (1.04% error), Parseval energy conservation, Friedel symmetry (<8e-16 error), and Fresnel z=0 identity (<5e-16 error) verified.
scientific_consequences: Ensures physical scaling and Fourier optics assumptions are mathematically sound.
proposed_remedy: Provide explicit unit conversion helpers and document optical coordinate conventions.

reproduction_procedure: Tasks T5 through T12 are described in documentation and manifest generators, but baseline evaluation scripts only exist for T1 through T4.
expected_behavior: Documentation must truthfully distinguish implemented and benchmarked tasks (T1-T4) from defined task manifests without baselines (T5-T12).
actual_behavior: Status matrix in benchmark report explicitly documents T1-T4 as evaluated and T5-T12 as defined manifest roadmaps.
scientific_consequences: Prevents misleading claims regarding the extent of evaluated machine learning tasks.
proposed_remedy: Document task readiness matrix clearly in README and benchmark reports.

reproduction_procedure: Inspect test_cxi.py. Tests validate export and structure of synthetic HDF5 arrays to CXI NeXus format; no experimental beamtime CXI files exist in the repo.
expected_behavior: Documentation must clearly disclose that CXI validation tests format compliance, not validation against real beamtime experimental data.
actual_behavior: Disclosed in DATASET_CARD.md that data are synthetic and experimental beamtime validation is unverified.
scientific_consequences: Prevents conflating format standard compliance with experimental validation.
proposed_remedy: Label experimental validation as UNVERIFIED in audits and document format scope.

reproduction_procedure: Cross-platform CI failed on test_hio_reconstructs_with_central_beamstop_unconstrained due to SSIM boundary padding bias and test_alignment_resolves_twin_image_and_translation due to bilinear interpolation blurring.
expected_behavior: Unconstrained Fourier projection strictly preserves iterate frequencies outside mask (SSIM > 0.95); Fourier translation resolves subpixel shifts matching registration oracle (SSIM > 0.90).
actual_behavior: Analytical projection verified; Fourier phase-ramp translation implemented; all 4 tests pass (SSIM unconstrained 0.9997, subpixel alignment 0.9396).
scientific_consequences: Restores mathematical validity and cross-platform reproducibility to phase retrieval benchmarks.
proposed_remedy: Implement exact sample covariance and edge-cropping in ssim_2d; implement fourier_shift_2d with subpixel parabolic peak refinement.

reproduction_procedure: Pipeline executed simulation before scenario resolution, causing V45 (S5 optical lab) to use fallback 1.24e-10 m X-ray wavelength and 75 um pitch rather than 632.8 nm He-Ne laser and 6.45 um pitch.
expected_behavior: Executed physical parameters must match scenario geometry exactly; polychromatic model must conserve integrated photon flux via 1/s^2 area scaling.
actual_behavior: Scenario geometry resolved prior to simulation; executed_params recorded in HDF5 metadata and manifest; flux conserved within 0.08% across spectral bins.
scientific_consequences: Guarantees physical authenticity and metadata provenance for experimental scenario benchmarks.
proposed_remedy: Bind physical parameters to SimulationConfig; propagate executed_params from forward models into manifest_record.

reproduction_procedure: Task T4 claimed 4-class hit classification but collapsed predictions to binary hit/non-hit on only 16 samples.
expected_behavior: Task 4A (Binary Hit Finding) and Task 4B (Four-Class Hit Characterization) must be independently defined, evaluated, and reported with full confusion matrices.
actual_behavior: Implemented classify_hit_binary and classify_hit_multiclass using real-space Patterson autocorrelation satellite ratios; evaluators report 2x2 and 4x4 confusion matrices.
scientific_consequences: Prevents over-claiming multiclass accuracy from binary thresholding.
proposed_remedy: Separate T4A and T4B in TASK_DEFINITIONS and benchmark evaluators; transparently report macro F1 and per-class recall.

reproduction_procedure: Evaluators caught KeyError and continued silently, altering evaluation cohorts when samples were missing from shards.
expected_behavior: Missing sample IDs, duplicated IDs, missing manifests, or split mismatches must raise explicit errors without silent dropping.
actual_behavior: All evaluators and dataset loaders enforce strict sample ID lookup, duplicate detection, and manifest existence checks.
scientific_consequences: Guarantees evaluation cohort integrity and prevents silent data leakage or evaluation on truncated sets.
proposed_remedy: Remove try/except KeyError pass-through; require strict sample ID lookup and manifest validation.

reproduction_procedure: Shards with empty or missing config_fingerprint passed verify_shard; shards could be skipped on resume while manifest rows remained incomplete.
expected_behavior: Fingerprint verification must fail closed on missing or empty hashes; shards are only skipped if HDF5, metadata.csv, and progress records are completely in sync; shard SHA-256 is tracked in integrity manifest.
actual_behavior: Implemented fail-closed fingerprint verification, persisted shard_integrity_manifest.json, and verified full manifest completeness prior to skipping.
scientific_consequences: Prevents data corruption or manifest truncation upon interrupted generation and restart.
proposed_remedy: Enforce strict fingerprint matching; record SHA-256 in shard_integrity_manifest.json; check metadata.csv sample presence on resume.

reproduction_procedure: ThreadPoolExecutor.map accumulated completed futures in memory faster than disk write, risking OOM on large shards.
expected_behavior: In-flight task submission must be bounded to 2 * num_workers, maintaining peak RSS < 4.0 GiB.
actual_behavior: Bounded worker queue implemented; peak RSS measured at 170.8 MB (1 worker), 178.0 MB (2 workers), and 212.0 MB (4 workers).
scientific_consequences: Ensures crash safety and strict memory bounds on resource-constrained compute environments.
proposed_remedy: Implement bounded in-flight future submission in pipeline.py; measure RSS across worker counts.
